It’s a story told in a disarmingly folksy manner with plucked guitar strings and down south homespun wisdom before it quietly reveals itself to be about something far more serious and startling, elements of an… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.title: Love of Your Life review – Margaret Qualley eats, grieves and loves in Amazon’s transporting saga
item.description: Toronto film festival: the actor gives one of her best performances to date in a smoothly made globe-trotting drama of a woman’s life after the loss of her husband There’s a jump scare about 30 minutes into the glossy romantic drama Love of Your Life that’s about as effective as anything you’ll see in a horror movie this year. The film is focused on the life and loves of Maya (Margaret Qualley), a twentysomething Boston nurse who meet-cutes with the nerdy and idiosyncratic Charlie (Gabriel Basso) during the purchase of a nightstand. item.title: Onwards and Sideways review – Rhys Ifans and Laura Linney lift solid Parkinson’s drama
item.description: Toronto film festival: Shakespeare in Love director John Madden’s feelgood – and bad – comedy-drama is powered by excellent performances and authenticity So far at this year’s Toronto film festival, I have seen three films involving someone with dementia and two featuring someone who has Aids. It’s not just a sign that the lineup could perhaps benefit from some more light relief but also that certain conditions and illnesses still tend to be covered more often than others on screen. item.title: 'Spiderman', 'Friends' o 'Lilo & Stitch': el desconocido impacto del 11-S en la cultura pop
item.description: Veinticinco años después, el cine, la televisión, la música y la literatura se convirtieron en el reflejo del trauma de Estados Unidos. En esta crónica especial analizamos los efectos que tuvieron los mortíferos atentados del 11 de septiembre 2001 sobre la cultura popular estadounidense, y cómo todas estas obras nos permiten hoy en día entender la complejidad del mundo que nació tras estos ataques terroristas. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Léa Hurel
